line.en: All summer the ant carried food home.
line.ms: Sepanjang musim panas, semut bawa makanan balik.
line.zh: 整个夏天，蚂蚁把食物搬回家。
line.pinyin: zhěnggè xiàtiān, mǎyǐ bǎ shíwù bān huíjiā.

line.en: The grasshopper sang and played.
line.ms: Belalang menyanyi dan bermain.
line.pinyin: zhàměng chànggē yòu wán shuǎ.

line.en: Then the rain came. It was cold.
line.ms: Kemudian hujan turun. Sejuk.
line.pinyin: hòulái xià yǔ le, hǎo lěng.

line.en: The grasshopper had no food.
line.ms: Belalang tiada makanan.
line.pinyin: zhàměng méi yǒu shíwù.

line.en: The ant shared with him. Now they both sing.
line.ms: Semut kongsi dengan dia. Sekarang dua-dua menyanyi.
line.zh: 蚂蚁分给它吃。现在它们一起唱歌。
line.pinyin: mǎyǐ fēn gěi tā chī. xiànzài tāmen yìqǐ chànggē.

title.pinyin: ài shuō huǎng de xiǎo nán hái

line.en: A boy looked after the sheep.
line.ms: Seorang budak jaga biri-biri.
line.pinyin: yí gè xiǎo nán hái kàn yáng.

line.en: For fun he shouted, "A wolf! A wolf!"
line.ms: Untuk berseronok dia jerit, "Serigala! Serigala!"
line.zh: 他开玩笑喊：“狼来了！狼来了！”
line.pinyin: tā kāi wán xiào hǎn:"láng lái le! láng lái le!"

line.en: Everyone ran to help. There was no wolf.
line.ms: Semua datang tolong. Tiada serigala.
line.pinyin: dà jiā pǎo lái bāng máng. méi yǒu láng.

line.en: Next time nobody came.
line.ms: Kali kedua, tiada siapa datang.
line.pinyin: dì èr cì, méi yǒu rén lái le.

line.en: So he told the truth after that. Words must be true.
line.ms: Selepas itu dia cakap benar. Kata-kata kena betul.
line.zh: 后来他说真话了。说话要老实。
line.pinyin: hòulái tā shuō zhēn huà le. shuō huà yào lǎo shí.

line.en: A thirsty crow found a pitcher.
line.ms: Burung gagak yang dahaga jumpa satu kendi.
line.zh: 一只渴了的乌鸦找到一个水壶。
line.pinyin: yì zhī kě le de wūyā zhǎo dào yí gè shuǐ hú.

line.en: The water was too far down.
line.ms: Air itu terlalu dalam.
line.pinyin: shuǐ zài hěn xià miàn, hē bú dào.

line.en: The crow dropped in a stone. Plop!
line.ms: Burung gagak masukkan batu. Plop!
line.pinyin: wūyā diū jìn yì kē shítou. dōng!

line.en: One stone, two stones, three stones.
line.ms: Satu batu, dua batu, tiga batu.
line.pinyin: yì kē, liǎng kē, sān kē shítou.

line.en: The water came up. The crow drank. Clever crow!
line.ms: Air naik. Burung gagak minum. Bijaknya!
line.zh: 水升上来了。乌鸦喝到水。真聪明！
line.pinyin: shuǐ shēng shàng lái le. wūyā hē dào shuǐ. zhēn cōng míng!

line.en: A fox saw sweet grapes up high.
line.ms: Sang rubah nampak anggur manis di atas.
line.zh: 狐狸看见高高的甜葡萄。
line.pinyin: hú lí kàn jiàn gāo gāo de tián pútao.

line.en: He jumped. He could not reach.
line.ms: Dia lompat. Tak sampai.
line.pinyin: tā tiào yí tiào, gòu bú dào.

line.en: He jumped again and again.
line.ms: Dia lompat lagi dan lagi.
line.pinyin: tā tiào ya tiào, hái shì gòu bú dào.

line.en: At last he walked away. "Never mind," he said.
line.ms: Akhirnya dia pergi. "Tak apalah," katanya.
line.zh: 最后它走开了。它说：“算了。”
line.pinyin: zuì hòu tā zǒu kāi le. tā shuō:"suàn le."

line.en: A little mouse woke a big lion.
line.ms: Seekor tikus kecil bangunkan singa besar.
line.pinyin: xiǎo lǎoshǔ chǎo xǐng le dà shīzi.

line.en: "Please let me go," said the mouse.
line.ms: "Tolong lepaskan saya," kata tikus.
line.pinyin: xiǎo lǎoshǔ shuō:"qǐng fàng wǒ zǒu."

line.en: The lion smiled and let him go.
line.ms: Singa tersenyum dan lepaskan dia.
line.pinyin: shīzi xiào le, fàng tā zǒu le.

line.en: Later the lion was stuck in a rope.
line.ms: Kemudian singa tersangkut dalam tali.
line.zh: 后来狮子被绳子缠住了。
line.pinyin: hòulái shīzi bèi shéng zi chán zhù le.

line.en: The little mouse chewed him free. Small friends help too!
line.ms: Tikus kecil gigit tali itu. Kawan kecil pun boleh tolong!
line.zh: 小老鼠咬断绳子。小朋友也能帮忙！
line.pinyin: xiǎo lǎoshǔ yǎo duàn shéng zi. xiǎo péngyou yě néng bāng máng!

line.en: The wind and the sun had a game.
line.ms: Angin dan matahari bermain satu permainan.
line.pinyin: fēng hé tàiyáng wán yí gè yóu xì.

line.en: "Who can take off that hat?"
line.ms: "Siapa boleh tanggalkan topi itu?"
line.pinyin: "shuí néng ràng màozi diào xià lái?"

line.en: The wind blew hard. The hat stayed on.
line.ms: Angin tiup kuat. Topi masih ada.
line.pinyin: fēng yòng lì chuī. màozi hái zài.

line.en: The sun shone warm and soft.
line.ms: Matahari bersinar hangat dan lembut.
line.pinyin: tàiyáng nuǎn nuǎn dì zhào zhe.

line.en: The hat came off by itself. Gentle wins!
line.ms: Topi tanggal sendiri. Lembut yang menang!
line.zh: 帽子自己掉了。温和赢了！
line.pinyin: màozi zì jǐ diào le. wēn hé yíng le!

line.en: Grandma baked a gingerbread man.
line.ms: Nenek bakar seorang biskut halia.
line.pinyin: nǎinai kǎo le yí gè jiāng bǐng rén.

line.en: Out of the oven he jumped!
line.ms: Dia lompat keluar dari oven!
line.pinyin: tā cóng lú zi lǐ tiào chū lái!

line.en: "Run, run, catch me if you can!"
line.ms: "Lari, lari, tangkap saya kalau boleh!"
line.pinyin: "pǎo ya pǎo, lái zhuī wǒ ya!"

line.en: The cat ran after him.
line.ms: Kucing lari mengejar dia.
line.pinyin: māo zhuī zhe tā pǎo.

line.en: The dog ran after him too.
line.ms: Anjing pun lari mengejar dia.
line.pinyin: gǒugou yě zhuī zhe tā pǎo.

line.en: The cow ran after him as well.
line.ms: Lembu pun lari mengejar dia.
line.pinyin: niú yě zhuī zhe tā pǎo.

line.en: He came to a wide river.
line.ms: Dia sampai ke sungai yang lebar.
line.pinyin: tā lái dào yì tiáo kuān kuān de hé.

line.en: A kind duck carried him across.
line.ms: Seekor itik yang baik bawa dia ke seberang.
line.zh: 一只好心的鸭子带他过河。
line.pinyin: yì zhī hǎo xīn de yāzi dài tā guò hé.

line.en: He ran all the way home to Grandma. Safe!
line.ms: Dia lari terus balik kepada nenek. Selamat!
line.zh: 他一路跑回奶奶家。安全了！
line.pinyin: tā yí lù pǎo huí nǎinai jiā. ān quán le!

title.ms: Si Rambut Emas dan Tiga Beruang
title.pinyin: jīn fā nǚ hái hé sān zhī xióng

line.en: A girl with golden hair walked in the woods.
line.ms: Seorang budak berambut emas jalan di dalam hutan.
line.zh: 一个金头发的女孩走进树林。
line.pinyin: yí gè jīn tóufa de nǚ hái zǒu jìn shù lín.

line.en: She found a little house.
line.ms: Dia jumpa sebuah rumah kecil.
line.pinyin: tā kàn jiàn yì jiān xiǎo fángzi.

line.en: Inside were three bowls of porridge.
line.ms: Di dalam ada tiga mangkuk bubur.
line.pinyin: lǐ miàn yǒu sān wǎn zhōu.

line.en: The big one was too hot.
line.ms: Yang besar terlalu panas.
line.pinyin: dà de tài tàng le.

line.en: The small one was just right. She ate it all.
line.ms: Yang kecil sedap betul. Dia makan semua.
line.pinyin: xiǎo de gāng gāng hǎo. tā chī guāng le.

line.en: Then she found three beds.
line.ms: Kemudian dia jumpa tiga katil.
line.pinyin: rán hòu tā kàn jiàn sān zhāng chuáng.

line.en: She fell asleep on the smallest bed.
line.ms: Dia tertidur di katil paling kecil.
line.zh: 她在最小的床上睡着了。
line.pinyin: tā zài zuì xiǎo de chuáng shàng shuì zháo le.

line.en: The three bears came home.
line.ms: Tiga beruang balik rumah.
line.pinyin: sān zhī xióng huíjiā le.

line.en: "Sorry!" she said, and ran home to her mama.
line.ms: "Maaf!" katanya, dan lari balik kepada mamanya.
line.zh: 她说：“对不起！”就跑回家找妈妈。
line.pinyin: tā shuō:"duì bù qǐ!"jiù pǎo huíjiā zhǎo māma.

line.en: Sang Kancil was hungry.
line.ms: Sang Kancil sedang lapar.
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù dù zi è le.

line.en: Across the river grew sweet, sweet fruit.
line.ms: Di seberang sungai ada buah-buahan yang manis.
line.zh: 河的对岸有很甜的果子。
line.pinyin: hé de duì àn yǒu hěn tián de guǒ zi.

line.en: But the river was full of crocodiles!
line.ms: Tapi sungai itu penuh dengan buaya!
line.pinyin: kěshì hé lǐ yǒu hǎo duō èyú!

line.en: Sang Kancil thought of a clever plan.
line.ms: Sang Kancil terfikir satu akal yang bijak.
line.zh: 小鼠鹿想到一个好办法。
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù xiǎng dào yí gè hǎo bàn fǎ.

line.en: "Crocodiles! The King told me to count you all," he called.
line.ms: "Buaya semua! Raja suruh saya kira kamu," katanya.
line.zh: 它大声说：“鳄鱼们，国王叫我来数一数你们！”
line.pinyin: tā dà shēng shuō:"èyú men, guó wáng jiào wǒ lái shǔ yi shǔ nǐmen!"

line.en: The crocodiles lined up in a long, long row.
line.ms: Buaya-buaya berbaris panjang di dalam sungai.
line.zh: 鳄鱼们排成长长的一排。
line.pinyin: èyú men pái chéng zhǎng zhǎng de yì pái.

line.en: Sang Kancil stepped on their backs. One, two, three…
line.ms: Sang Kancil pijak belakang mereka. Satu, dua, tiga…
line.zh: 小鼠鹿踩在它们的背上。一、二、三……
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù cǎi zài tāmen de bèi shàng. yī, èr, sān……

line.en: Hop, hop, hop — all the way across!
line.ms: Lompat, lompat, lompat — sampai ke seberang!
line.pinyin: tiào, tiào, tiào—— tiào dào duì àn le!

line.en: Sang Kancil ate the sweet fruit and said thank you.
line.ms: Sang Kancil makan buah manis itu dan cakap terima kasih.
line.zh: 小鼠鹿吃到甜果子，还说了谢谢。
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù chī dào tián guǒ zi, hái shuō le xièxie.

line.en: Clever Sang Kancil! A clever head beats a big body.
line.ms: Bijaknya Sang Kancil! Akal lebih berguna daripada badan besar.
line.zh: 聪明的小鼠鹿！聪明比力气更有用。
line.pinyin: cōng míng de xiǎo shǔ lù! cōng míng bǐ lìqi gèng yǒu yòng.

line.en: Sang Kancil was very small.
line.ms: Sang Kancil sangat kecil.
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù hěn xiǎo.

line.en: A big elephant blocked the path.
line.ms: Seekor gajah besar halang jalan.
line.pinyin: yì zhī dàxiàng dǎng zhù le lù.

line.en: "Move, please," said Sang Kancil.
line.ms: "Tolong beralih," kata Sang Kancil.
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù shuō:"qǐng ràng yí ràng."

line.en: "I am big. You move," said the elephant.
line.ms: "Saya besar. Awak beralih," kata gajah.
line.pinyin: dàxiàng shuō:"wǒ dà, nǐ ràng."

line.en: Sang Kancil had a clever idea.
line.ms: Sang Kancil ada satu akal yang bijak.
line.zh: 小鼠鹿想到一个好办法。
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù xiǎng dào yí gè hǎo bàn fǎ.

line.en: "The mud ahead is very deep," he said.
line.ms: "Tanah di depan sangat dalam," katanya.
line.zh: 它说：“前面的地很软很深。”
line.pinyin: tā shuō:"qián miàn de dì hěn ruǎn hěn shēn."

line.en: The elephant walked around it carefully.
line.ms: Gajah jalan mengelilinginya dengan hati-hati.
line.pinyin: dàxiàng xiǎoxīn dì rào guò qù le.

line.en: Now the path was clear. "Thank you, friend!"
line.ms: Sekarang jalan sudah lapang. "Terima kasih, kawan!"
line.pinyin: lù tōng le."xièxie nǐ, péngyou!"

line.en: Sang Kancil met a big tiger in the forest.
line.ms: Sang Kancil jumpa seekor harimau besar di dalam hutan.
line.zh: 小鼠鹿在森林里遇到一只大老虎。
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù zài sēnlín lǐ yù dào yì zhī dà lǎohǔ.

line.en: "I am very hungry," growled the tiger.
line.ms: "Aku sangat lapar," kata harimau itu.
line.pinyin: lǎohǔ shuō:"wǒ hǎo è a."

line.en: Sang Kancil was small. He had to be clever.
line.ms: Sang Kancil kecil saja. Dia kena guna akal.
line.zh: 小鼠鹿很小，它要用聪明的办法。
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù hěn xiǎo, tā yào yòng cōng míng de bàn fǎ.

line.en: "Come, I will show you the king of the forest," he said.
line.ms: "Mari, saya tunjuk raja hutan," katanya.
line.zh: 它说：“来，我带你去看森林之王。”
line.pinyin: tā shuō:"lái, wǒ dài nǐ qù kàn sēnlín zhī wáng."

line.en: He led the tiger to a quiet pool of water.
line.ms: Dia bawa harimau ke sebuah kolam yang tenang.
line.zh: 它带老虎来到一个安静的水池。
line.pinyin: tā dài lǎohǔ lái dào yí gè ān jìng de shuǐ chí.

line.en: "Look inside," said Sang Kancil.
line.ms: "Tengok dalam air," kata Sang Kancil.
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù shuō:"kàn kàn shuǐ lǐ miàn."

line.en: The tiger saw another big tiger looking back at him.
line.ms: Harimau nampak seekor harimau besar memandangnya.
line.zh: 老虎看见另一只大老虎在看它。
line.pinyin: lǎohǔ kàn jiàn lìng yì zhī dà lǎohǔ zài kàn tā.

line.en: He roared. The tiger in the water roared too!
line.ms: Dia mengaum. Harimau di dalam air pun mengaum!
line.zh: 它大声吼。水里的老虎也吼！
line.pinyin: tā dà shēng hǒu. shuǐ lǐ de lǎohǔ yě hǒu!

line.en: The tiger ran away, all the way home.
line.ms: Harimau itu lari jauh, terus balik rumah.
line.zh: 老虎吓跑了，一直跑回家。
line.pinyin: lǎohǔ xià pǎo le, yìzhí pǎo huíjiā.

line.en: Sang Kancil smiled. A clever head beats a loud roar.
line.ms: Sang Kancil tersenyum. Akal lebih berguna daripada auman yang kuat.
line.zh: 小鼠鹿笑了。聪明比大声更有用。
line.pinyin: xiǎo shǔ lù xiào le. cōng míng bǐ dà shēng gèng yǒu yòng.

line.en: A little girl wore a red hood.
line.ms: Seorang budak perempuan pakai tudung merah.
line.pinyin: xiǎo nǚ hái dài zhe hóng màozi.

line.en: Mama gave her a basket of bread.
line.ms: Mama beri dia bakul roti.
line.pinyin: māma gěi tā yì lán miànbāo.

line.en: "Take this to Grandma," said Mama.
line.ms: "Bawa ini kepada nenek," kata mama.
line.pinyin: māma shuō:"dài qù gěi nǎinai."

line.en: She walked through the trees.
line.ms: Dia jalan melalui pokok-pokok.
line.pinyin: tā zǒu guò shù lín.

line.en: A wolf watched her from behind a tree.
line.ms: Seekor serigala perhatikan dia dari belakang pokok.
line.pinyin: yì zhī láng zài shù hòu kàn zhe tā.

line.en: The wolf ran to Grandma's house first.
line.ms: Serigala lari ke rumah nenek dulu.
line.pinyin: láng xiān pǎo dào nǎinai jiā.

line.en: Grandma heard him and hid in the cupboard.
line.ms: Nenek dengar dia dan sembunyi dalam almari.
line.zh: 奶奶听见了，躲进柜子里。
line.pinyin: nǎinai tīng jiàn le, duǒ jìn guìzi lǐ.

line.en: The girl came in. "You are not Grandma!"
line.ms: Budak itu masuk. "Awak bukan nenek!"
line.zh: 女孩进来了。“你不是奶奶！”
line.pinyin: nǚ hái jìn lái le."nǐ bú shì nǎinai!"

line.en: She shouted loudly. The wolf ran away!
line.ms: Dia jerit kuat. Serigala lari!
line.pinyin: tā dà shēng hǎn. láng pǎo diào le!

line.en: Grandma came out. They ate the bread together.
line.ms: Nenek keluar. Mereka makan roti bersama.
line.zh: 奶奶出来了。她们一起吃面包。
line.pinyin: nǎinai chū lái le. tāmen yìqǐ chī miànbāo.

line.en: Three little sheep went out to build houses.
line.ms: Tiga anak biri-biri keluar nak bina rumah.
line.zh: 三只小绵羊出去盖房子。
line.pinyin: sān zhī xiǎo miányáng chū qù gài fángzi.

line.en: The first sheep built a house of straw.
line.ms: Anak biri-biri pertama bina rumah jerami.
line.zh: 第一只小绵羊盖了草房子。
line.pinyin: dì yì zhī xiǎo miányáng gài le cǎo fángzi.

line.en: The second sheep built a house of sticks.
line.ms: Anak biri-biri kedua bina rumah kayu.
line.zh: 第二只小绵羊盖了木房子。
line.pinyin: dì èr zhī xiǎo miányáng gài le mù fángzi.

line.en: The third sheep built a strong house of bricks.
line.ms: Anak biri-biri ketiga bina rumah batu yang kuat.
line.zh: 第三只小绵羊盖了坚固的砖房子。
line.pinyin: dì sān zhī xiǎo miányáng gài le jiān gù de zhuān fángzi.

line.en: A big wolf came along. He huffed and he puffed.
line.ms: Seekor serigala besar datang. Dia hembus kuat-kuat.
line.zh: 大灰狼来了。它用力吹呀吹。
line.pinyin: dà huī láng lái le. tā yòng lì chuī ya chuī.

line.en: Whoosh! The straw house blew away!
line.ms: Wuuush! Rumah jerami itu terbang!
line.pinyin: hū—— cǎo fángzi bèi chuī dào le!

line.en: Whoosh! The stick house blew away too!
line.ms: Wuuush! Rumah kayu pun terbang juga!
line.pinyin: hū—— mù fángzi yě bèi chuī dào le!

line.en: The three sheep ran into the brick house.
line.ms: Tiga anak biri-biri masuk ke dalam rumah batu.
line.zh: 三只小绵羊跑进砖房子里。
line.pinyin: sān zhī xiǎo miányáng pǎo jìn zhuān fángzi lǐ.

line.en: The wolf huffed and puffed, but the house did not move.
line.ms: Serigala hembus dan hembus, tapi rumah itu tak bergerak.
line.zh: 大灰狼吹呀吹，房子一点也不动。
line.pinyin: dà huī láng chuī ya chuī, fángzi yìdiǎn yě bú dòng.

line.en: So the wolf went home. The three sheep were safe.
line.ms: Serigala balik rumah. Tiga anak biri-biri semua selamat.
line.zh: 大灰狼只好回家了。三只小绵羊都很安全。
line.pinyin: dà huī láng zhī hǎo huíjiā le. sān zhī xiǎo miányáng dōu hěn ān quán.

line.en: The hare and the tortoise wanted to race.
line.ms: Arnab dan kura-kura nak berlumba.
line.pinyin: tùzi hé wūguī yào sài pǎo.

line.en: The hare ran very, very fast.
line.ms: Arnab berlari sangat pantas.
line.pinyin: tùzi pǎo dé hěn kuài hěn kuài.

line.en: The tortoise walked slowly, step by step.
line.ms: Kura-kura jalan perlahan-perlahan, selangkah demi selangkah.
line.zh: 乌龟慢慢地走，一步一步。
line.pinyin: wūguī màn màn dì zǒu, yí bù yí bù.

line.en: The hare was far ahead. "I will nap a little," he said.
line.ms: Arnab sudah jauh di depan. "Aku nak tidur sekejap," katanya.
line.zh: 兔子跑到很前面。它说：“我要睡一下。”
line.pinyin: tùzi pǎo dào hěn qián miàn. tā shuō:"wǒ yào shuì yí xià."

line.en: The hare fell asleep under a tree.
line.ms: Arnab tertidur di bawah pokok.
line.pinyin: tùzi zài shù xià shuì zháo le.

line.en: The tortoise kept walking. He did not stop.
line.ms: Kura-kura terus jalan. Dia tak berhenti.
line.zh: 乌龟一直走，一直走，没有停。
line.pinyin: wūguī yìzhí zǒu, yìzhí zǒu, méi yǒu tíng.

line.en: The tortoise walked right past the sleeping hare.
line.ms: Kura-kura lalu di sebelah arnab yang tidur.
line.pinyin: wūguī zǒu guò shuì zháo de tùzi.

line.en: The hare woke up and ran, but it was too late!
line.ms: Arnab bangun dan berlari, tapi dah terlambat!
line.zh: 兔子醒来就跑，可是太晚了！
line.pinyin: tùzi xǐng lái jiù pǎo, kěshì tài wǎn le!

line.en: The tortoise won. Slow and steady wins the race.
line.ms: Kura-kura menang! Perlahan-perlahan pun boleh menang.
line.zh: 乌龟赢了！慢慢来，也会赢。
line.pinyin: wūguī yíng le! màn màn lái, yě huì yíng.

line.en: Five eggs sat in a nest.
line.ms: Lima biji telur ada dalam sarang.
line.pinyin: wō lǐ yǒu wǔ gè dàn.

line.en: Four little ducks came out. Then one more.
line.ms: Empat anak itik keluar. Kemudian satu lagi.
line.zh: 四只小鸭出来了。然后又一只。
line.pinyin: sì zhī xiǎo yā chū lái le. rán hòu yòu yì zhī.

line.en: The last one was big and grey.
line.ms: Yang akhir besar dan kelabu.
line.pinyin: zuì hòu yì zhī yòu dà yòu huī.

line.en: "You look different," said the others.
line.ms: "Awak nampak lain," kata yang lain.
line.pinyin: bié de yā shuō:"nǐ bù yíyàng."

line.en: He felt sad and swam away alone.
line.ms: Dia rasa sedih dan berenang sendiri.
line.zh: 它很难过，一个人游走了。
line.pinyin: tā hěn nán guò, yí gè rén yóu zǒu le.

line.en: All winter he swam and grew.
line.ms: Sepanjang musim sejuk dia berenang dan membesar.
line.zh: 整个冬天它游呀游，长大了。
line.pinyin: zhěnggè dōng tiān tā yóu ya yóu, zhǎng dà le.

line.en: One day he looked in the water.
line.ms: Satu hari dia tengok dalam air.
line.pinyin: yǒu yìtiān tā kàn kàn shuǐ lǐ.

line.en: A beautiful swan looked back!
line.ms: Seekor kayu angsa yang cantik memandangnya!
line.zh: 一只美丽的天鹅看着它！
line.pinyin: yì zhī měi lì de tiāné kàn zhe tā!

line.en: He was a swan all along. Everyone grows into themselves.
line.ms: Dia memang angsa. Semua orang membesar jadi diri sendiri.
line.zh: 它本来就是天鹅。每个人都会长成自己。
line.pinyin: tā běn lái jiù shì tiāné. měi gè rén dōu huì zhǎng chéng zì jǐ.

title.en: The Kind Sister and the Unkind Sister

line.en: Bawang Putih was a kind girl.
line.ms: Bawang Putih seorang budak yang baik.
line.zh: 白蒜是一个善良的女孩。
line.pinyin: bái suàn shì yí gè shàn liáng de nǚ hái.

line.en: Bawang Merah was not kind to her.
line.ms: Bawang Merah tidak baik dengan dia.
line.pinyin: hóng cōng duì tā bù hǎo.

line.en: Bawang Putih washed the clothes at the river.
line.ms: Bawang Putih basuh kain di sungai.
line.pinyin: bái suàn zài hé biān xǐ yīfu.

line.en: One day a shirt floated away.
line.ms: Satu hari sehelai baju hanyut.
line.zh: 有一天一件衣服漂走了。
line.pinyin: yǒu yìtiān yí jiàn yīfu piāo zǒu le.

line.en: She followed the river a long way.
line.ms: Dia ikut sungai jauh sekali.
line.pinyin: tā yán zhe hé zǒu le hěn yuǎn.

line.en: She met a kind grandmother.
line.ms: Dia jumpa seorang nenek yang baik.
line.zh: 她遇到一位好心的奶奶。
line.pinyin: tā yù dào yí wèi hǎo xīn de nǎinai.

line.en: "Have you seen my shirt?" she asked.
line.ms: "Nenek nampak baju saya?" dia tanya.
line.zh: 她问：“奶奶看见我的衣服吗？”
line.pinyin: tā wèn:"nǎinai kàn jiàn wǒ de yīfu ma?"

line.en: "Help me first, then I will help you."
line.ms: "Tolong nenek dulu, nanti nenek tolong awak."
line.pinyin: "xiān bāng bāng wǒ, wǒ zài bāng nǐ."

line.en: Bawang Putih swept and cooked rice.
line.ms: Bawang Putih sapu dan masak nasi.
line.pinyin: bái suàn sǎo dì, hái zhǔ le fàn.

line.en: She worked kindly and never complained.
line.ms: Dia bekerja dengan baik dan tak merungut.
line.zh: 她做得很用心，没有抱怨。
line.pinyin: tā zuò dé hěn yòng xīn, méi yǒu bào yuàn.

line.en: The grandmother gave her the shirt back.
line.ms: Nenek beri baju itu balik.
line.pinyin: nǎinai bǎ yīfu hái gěi tā.

line.en: And a small basket as a gift.
line.ms: Dan sebuah bakul kecil sebagai hadiah.
line.pinyin: hái sòng tā yí gè xiǎo lánzi.

line.en: Inside was gold. She ran home happily.
line.ms: Di dalamnya ada emas. Dia lari balik dengan gembira.
line.zh: 里面是金子。她高高兴兴跑回家。
line.pinyin: lǐ miàn shì jīn zi. tā gāo gāo xīng xīng pǎo huíjiā.

line.en: She shared it with everyone, even Bawang Merah.
line.ms: Dia kongsi dengan semua, termasuk Bawang Merah.
line.zh: 她和大家分享，连红葱也有。
line.pinyin: tā hé dà jiā fēn xiǎng, lián hóng cōng yě yǒu.

line.en: Kindness comes back. That is the whole story.
line.ms: Kebaikan akan balik. Itulah ceritanya.
line.zh: 善良会回来。这就是故事。
line.pinyin: shàn liáng huì huí lái. zhè jiù shì gù shì.

line.en: A kind girl lived with two unkind sisters.
line.ms: Seorang budak yang baik tinggal dengan dua kakak yang tidak baik.
line.zh: 一个善良的女孩和两个不好心的姐姐住在一起。
line.pinyin: yí gè shàn liáng de nǚ hái hé liǎng gè bù hǎo xīn de jiějie zhù zài yìqǐ.

line.en: She swept the floor every day.
line.ms: Dia sapu lantai setiap hari.
line.pinyin: tā měi tiān sǎo dì.

line.en: She sat by the fire, so they called her Cinderella.
line.ms: Dia duduk dekat api, jadi mereka panggil dia Cinderella.
line.zh: 她常坐在火边，大家叫她灰姑娘。
line.pinyin: tā cháng zuò zài huǒ biān, dà jiā jiào tā huī gū niáng.

line.en: A letter came. A ball at the palace!
line.ms: Satu surat datang. Ada majlis tari di istana!
line.zh: 来了一封信。宫里有舞会！
line.pinyin: lái le yì fēng xìn. gōng lǐ yǒu wǔhuì!

line.en: "You cannot come," said the sisters.
line.ms: "Awak tak boleh datang," kata kakak-kakak itu.
line.pinyin: jiějie men shuō:"nǐ bù néng qù."

line.en: Cinderella sat down and cried a little.
line.ms: Cinderella duduk dan menangis sedikit.
line.zh: 灰姑娘坐下来，哭了一会儿。
line.pinyin: huī gū niáng zuò xià lái, kū le yí huì ér.

line.en: Then a kind fairy appeared.
line.ms: Kemudian seorang pari-pari yang baik muncul.
line.zh: 然后一位好心的仙女出现了。
line.pinyin: rán hòu yí wèi hǎo xīn de xiānnǚ chū xiàn le.

line.en: She made a beautiful dress.
line.ms: Dia buat satu gaun yang cantik.
line.zh: 她变出一件漂亮的裙子。
line.pinyin: tā biàn chū yí jiàn piāo liàng de qún zi.

line.en: And two shining shoes.
line.ms: Dan dua kasut yang berkilau.
line.pinyin: hái yǒu liǎng zhī shǎn shǎn de xiézi.

line.en: "Be home by midnight," said the fairy.
line.ms: "Balik sebelum tengah malam," kata pari-pari.
line.pinyin: xiānnǚ shuō:"bàn yè qián yào huíjiā."

line.en: Cinderella danced at the ball.
line.ms: Cinderella menari di majlis itu.
line.pinyin: huī gū niáng zài wǔhuì shàng tiào wǔ.

line.en: The clock struck twelve. She ran home!
line.ms: Jam pukul dua belas. Dia lari balik!
line.pinyin: zhōng qiāo shí èr diǎn. tā pǎo huíjiā!

line.en: One shoe stayed on the steps.
line.ms: Satu kasut tertinggal di tangga.
line.pinyin: yì zhī xiézi liú zài tái jiē shàng.

line.en: The prince looked for the girl whose foot it fit.
line.ms: Raja muda cari budak yang kakinya sesuai.
line.zh: 王子去找鞋子合脚的女孩。
line.pinyin: wángzǐ qù zhǎo xiézi hé jiǎo de nǚ hái.

line.en: It fit Cinderella. They were friends, and she was happy at last.
line.ms: Ia sesuai dengan Cinderella. Mereka berkawan, dan dia gembira akhirnya.
line.zh: 鞋子正好合灰姑娘的脚。他们成了朋友，她终于很快乐。
line.pinyin: xiézi zhèng hǎo hé huī gū niáng de jiǎo. tāmen chéng le péngyou, tā zhōng yú hěn kuài lè.

line.en: A princess had skin as white as snow.
line.ms: Seorang puteri ada kulit putih seperti salji.
line.zh: 一位公主的皮肤像雪一样白。
line.pinyin: yí wèi gōngzhǔ de pí fū xiàng xuě yíyàng bái.

line.en: Everyone called her Snow White.
line.ms: Semua orang panggil dia Puteri Salji.
line.pinyin: dà jiā jiào tā bái xuě gōngzhǔ.

line.en: The queen had a magic mirror.
line.ms: Permaisuri ada cermin ajaib.
line.pinyin: wáng hòu yǒu yí miàn mó jìng.

line.en: "Who is the fairest?" she asked it.
line.ms: "Siapa paling cantik?" dia tanya.
line.pinyin: tā wèn:"shuí zuì měi?"

line.en: "Snow White is," said the mirror.
line.ms: "Puteri Salji," kata cermin itu.
line.pinyin: mó jìng shuō:"bái xuě gōngzhǔ."

line.en: The queen was jealous. Snow White went to the forest.
line.ms: Permaisuri cemburu. Puteri Salji pergi ke hutan.
line.zh: 王后很嫉妒。白雪公主去了森林。
line.pinyin: wáng hòu hěn jí dù. bái xuě gōngzhǔ qù le sēnlín.

line.en: She found a tiny house.
line.ms: Dia jumpa sebuah rumah yang kecil.
line.zh: 她找到一间小小的房子。
line.pinyin: tā zhǎo dào yì jiān xiǎo xiǎo de fángzi.

line.en: Seven little friends lived there.
line.ms: Tujuh kawan kecil tinggal di sana.
line.pinyin: qī gè xiǎo péngyou zhù zài nà lǐ.

line.en: They shared their bread with her.
line.ms: Mereka kongsi roti dengan dia.
line.pinyin: tāmen bǎ miànbāo fēn gěi tā.

line.en: The queen came with a red apple.
line.ms: Permaisuri datang dengan sebiji epal merah.
line.zh: 王后带着一个红苹果来了。
line.pinyin: wáng hòu dài zhe yí gè hóng píngguǒ lái le.

line.en: Snow White took one bite and fell fast asleep.
line.ms: Puteri Salji makan sedikit dan terus tertidur.
line.zh: 白雪公主咬了一口，就睡着了。
line.pinyin: bái xuě gōngzhǔ yǎo le yì kǒu, jiù shuì zháo le.

line.en: Her friends were very sad.
line.ms: Kawan-kawannya sangat sedih.
line.pinyin: xiǎo péngyou men hěn nán guò.

line.en: They kept her safe and waited.
line.ms: Mereka jaga dia dan tunggu.
line.pinyin: tāmen shǒu zhe tā, děng zhe.

line.en: A prince came and called her name softly.
line.ms: Seorang raja muda datang dan panggil namanya perlahan.
line.zh: 一位王子来了，轻轻叫她的名字。
line.pinyin: yí wèi wángzǐ lái le, qīng qīng jiào tā de míng zì.

line.en: Snow White woke up and smiled. Everyone was safe.
line.ms: Puteri Salji bangun dan tersenyum. Semua selamat.
line.zh: 白雪公主醒来笑了。大家都平安。
line.pinyin: bái xuě gōngzhǔ xǐng lái xiào le. dà jiā dōu píng ān.
